skills.name: start
skills.desc: Guides a first-time user through onboarding and picks the right workflow. Use when the user is new, just cloned the template, has no idea yet, asks where to begin, or wants to bring in existing work.

skills.name: help
skills.desc: What should I do next? Use when stuck or unsure what comes next.

skills.name: project-stage-detect
skills.desc: Analyze project state, detect the stage, identify gaps and recommend next steps. 'Where are we in development?'

skills.name: setup-target
skills.desc: Choose what this project promises to run on: browser, VST3, CLAP, AU, AAX, standalone or hardware. Records it and checks the machine can build it.

skills.name: adopt
skills.desc: Brownfield audit: bring an existing module or plugin idea into the studio with a numbered migration plan. Checks that existing artifacts actually work.

skills.name: settings
skills.desc: View or change studio config: rigor, automation, targets, stage.

skills.name: studio-validate
skills.desc: Run the validator: checks every command, flag and guide named in this studio against the installed CLI, then tries each capability on this project. Use after install or an upgrade, or to report what does not work.

skills.name: studio-gap
skills.desc: Record something the studio or Maru could not do: a failing command, a missing capability or misleading documentation. Use when a tool fails or a skill hits a dead end.

skills.name: brainstorm
skills.desc: Guides the user through finding and choosing a plugin concept. Use when they want ideas, a new concept, or have a musical problem but no plugin yet.

skills.name: map-signal-flow
skills.desc: Decompose a concept into signal blocks, controls and their dependencies, and set the design order.

skills.name: design-module
skills.desc: Section-by-section Plugin Design Document for one module or block. Walks through each required section, one at a time.

skills.name: quick-design
skills.desc: Lightweight spec for small changes: a tuning adjustment or one new control. Skips the full PDD.

skills.name: review-all-designs
skills.desc: Holistic review across PDDs: contradictions, controls that do the same thing, and too many controls.

skills.name: design-review
skills.desc: Reviews one design document for completeness, consistency, implementability and whether it can be tested.

skills.name: propagate-design-change
skills.desc: Finds architecture decisions and stories made stale by a changed design document, and resolves each.

skills.name: consistency-check
skills.desc: Check parameter names, ranges and units agree across the contract, face, presets, design documents and manual.

skills.name: sound-bible
skills.desc: Author the Sound Bible: the sonic identity, references and level policy that all sound work must follow.

skills.name: face-bible
skills.desc: Author the Face Bible: visual identity, references, type, colour and control style.

skills.name: asset-spec
skills.desc: Specs for samples, impulse responses and images: format, rights, slot and, if generated, the prompt and seed.

skills.name: asset-audit
skills.desc: Audit assets against the spec: orphans, missing rights, size and format.

skills.name: generate-sounds
skills.desc: Generate audio, a kit or MIDI with hosted jobs. Asks first, since jobs can cost money.

skills.name: ux-design
skills.desc: Section-by-section UX spec for the face: what is visible at rest, the first minute, and how controls are reached.

skills.name: ux-review
skills.desc: Validate a UX spec or the built face: accessibility, concision and agreement with the design.

skills.name: face-from-reference
skills.desc: Build the face from a reference image inside this module: parameters first, then the face, DSP last.

skills.name: parameter-pass
skills.desc: Design or change the parameter contract: names, ranges, tapers, defaults, order.

skills.name: create-architecture
skills.desc: Author the technical plan before code: owner, starter, Graph or Processor, DSP candidates, wiring, prerequisites and verification order.

skills.name: architecture-decision
skills.desc: Create an ADR documenting one technical decision: context, alternatives and consequences.

skills.name: architecture-review
skills.desc: Map design requirements to decisions. Finds gaps, conflicts between ADRs, and unsupported assumptions about Maru.

skills.name: create-control-manifest
skills.desc: Build a short must-do and never-do list for this module from accepted ADRs.

skills.name: create-epics
skills.desc: Turn the design and architecture into epics, one per module area.

skills.name: create-stories
skills.desc: Break one epic, or the brief at minimal rigor, into stories with acceptance criteria.

skills.name: story-readiness
skills.desc: Check whether a story is ready: clear acceptance, no open questions, valid decisions.

skills.name: dev-story
skills.desc: Implement one story: code, check, evidence. Use when the user says to build or implement a story.

skills.name: story-done
skills.desc: Close a finished story: verify each acceptance item and record deviations.

skills.name: sprint-plan
skills.desc: Create or update a sprint plan from the milestone and capacity.

skills.name: sprint-status
skills.desc: Fast sprint snapshot. 'How is the sprint going?'

skills.name: estimate
skills.desc: Estimate effort from complexity, dependencies and risk, with a confidence level.

skills.name: code-review
skills.desc: Review module code: realtime safety first, then ownership, contract use and tests.

skills.name: gain-staging
skills.desc: Check output against input level, per preset and across inputs. The audio version of a balance check.

skills.name: sound-compare
skills.desc: Compare the module against a reference recording or plugin for a chosen musical property.

skills.name: content-audit
skills.desc: Audit planned against built: controls, presets, demos and assets.

skills.name: scope-check
skills.desc: Scope creep check: current scope against the brief. 'Any scope creep?'

skills.name: perf-profile
skills.desc: Performance review: find expensive code, measure against budgets, rank optimizations.

skills.name: tech-debt
skills.desc: Track and prioritize technical debt: TODOs, temporary labels, workarounds.

skills.name: gate-check
skills.desc: Ready to advance between phases? Returns PASS, CONCERNS, NOT ASSESSED or FAIL with blockers. 'Can we move on?'

skills.name: security-audit
skills.desc: Security review before publishing: dependencies, credentials, licence settings and source visibility.

skills.name: qa-plan
skills.desc: QA plan for a sprint or release: which checks are automated, what a person must listen to, and which hosts.

skills.name: smoke-check
skills.desc: Critical-path smoke gate: does it compile, load, render and show its face?

skills.name: listening-test
skills.desc: Structured listening session: a script for a person, then a report of what they heard. The audio version of a playtest.

skills.name: soak-test
skills.desc: Long-running behaviour: hours of audio, automation, tails, memory, denormals.

skills.name: regression-suite
skills.desc: Map tests to critical behaviour, find fixed bugs without a regression test, and extend the qualification tapes.

skills.name: test-setup
skills.desc: Set up tests and CI: test script, qualification tapes and a GitHub Actions workflow.

skills.name: test-helpers
skills.desc: Write project test helpers: tape builders, event builders and assertions.

skills.name: test-evidence-review
skills.desc: Review the quality of tests and evidence, not just their existence. ADEQUATE, INCOMPLETE or MISSING.

skills.name: test-flakiness
skills.desc: Find flaky checks from CI logs or repeated runs.

skills.name: host-matrix
skills.desc: Maintain the host and format compatibility matrix, with evidence per cell.

skills.name: state-recall
skills.desc: Test save and recall: parameters, presets, authored state and automation.

skills.name: midi-test
skills.desc: Test MIDI behaviour: note lifecycle, stuck notes, overlapping notes and capacity.

skills.name: skill-test
skills.desc: Validate this studio's skills: structure, and every command, flag and guide they name.

skills.name: skill-improve
skills.desc: Improve a skill through a test, fix and retest loop.

skills.name: milestone-review
skills.desc: Milestone review: completeness, quality, risk and a go or no-go recommendation.

skills.name: retrospective
skills.desc: Sprint or milestone retrospective with actions for next time.

skills.name: bug-report
skills.desc: Structured bug report: what you did, what you heard, what you expected, and how to reproduce it.

skills.name: bug-triage
skills.desc: Re-evaluate open bugs: priority against severity, and what is a systemic trend.

skills.name: reverse-document
skills.desc: Generate missing design or architecture docs from existing code.

skills.name: onboard
skills.desc: Onboarding doc for a new contributor or agent: project state, conventions and priorities.

skills.name: localize
skills.desc: Face and manual translation: find hardcoded strings, extract a table, check lengths.

skills.name: prototype
skills.desc: Test one risky idea quickly inside the module workbench. PROCEED, PIVOT or KILL.

skills.name: vertical-slice
skills.desc: End-to-end validation: one control, one sound, one preset, from face to publication dry run.

skills.name: preset-pass
skills.desc: Write or revise factory presets: names, order and range.

skills.name: demo-pass
skills.desc: Produce demo audio and the first impression on the module page.

skills.name: build-plugin
skills.desc: Build native plug-in formats and read the report. A binary alone does not prove anything.

skills.name: publish
skills.desc: Publish this module online. Dry run first, and always after an explicit yes.

skills.name: release-checklist
skills.desc: Pre-release checklist: build verification, levels, presets, rights, version.

skills.name: launch-checklist
skills.desc: Launch readiness across every department: code, sound, face, docs, page, community, legal. Go or no-go.

skills.name: changelog
skills.desc: Generate a changelog from git commits and stories.

skills.name: patch-notes
skills.desc: Musician-facing notes from the changelog.

skills.name: hotfix
skills.desc: Emergency fix outside the sprint, with a full record and a regression test.

skills.name: day-one-patch
skills.desc: First patch after launch: known issues and the first feedback, with a rollback plan.

skills.name: team-effect
skills.desc: Orchestrate the effect team: product-designer, parameter-designer, dsp-engineer, face-engineer, sound-director, qa-tester. Coordinates several agents on one feature.

skills.name: team-instrument
skills.desc: Orchestrate the instrument team: product-designer, voice-engineer, parameter-designer, face-engineer, sound-director, qa-tester. Coordinates several agents on one feature.

skills.name: team-face
skills.desc: Orchestrate the face team: ux-designer, art-director, ui-kit-specialist, face-engineer, accessibility-specialist. Coordinates several agents on one feature.

skills.name: team-sound
skills.desc: Orchestrate the sound team: sound-director, dsp-library-specialist, dsp-engineer, preset-designer, demo-producer. Coordinates several agents on one feature.

skills.name: team-presets
skills.desc: Orchestrate the preset and content team: sound-director, preset-designer, sample-librarian, copywriter. Coordinates several agents on one feature.

skills.name: team-polish
skills.desc: Orchestrate the polish team: performance-analyst, face-engineer, preset-designer, qa-tester. Coordinates several agents on one feature.

skills.name: team-qa
skills.desc: Orchestrate the QA team: qa-lead, qa-tester, host-compat-engineer. Coordinates several agents on one feature.

skills.name: team-release
skills.desc: Orchestrate the release team: release-manager, qa-lead, security-engineer, publishing-specialist. Coordinates several agents on one feature.

skills.name: team-launch
skills.desc: Orchestrate the launch team: release-manager, copywriter, docs-lead, community-manager, demo-producer. Coordinates several agents on one feature.
